outcome: Expression of ACE and ACE2 in placenta and white adipose tissue
cohort: The study included 49 pregnant women (lean and obese) and their respective newborns.
finding: Maternal obesity was associated with increased ACE expression and decreased ACE2 expression in the placenta and adipose tissue, with ACE2 levels negatively correlated with pre-pregnancy BMI and total cholesterol.
cross-section timing: Samples (placenta and adipose tissue) were collected during or immediately after birth.
